What is the best estimate of the number corresponding to P?
figure_description: A horizontal number line with an arrow pointing right. Four evenly spaced vertical tick marks are labeled below with the numbers 0, 1, 2, and 3. On the line between 1 and 2, slightly to the right of 1 (at approximately one-fifth of the distance from 1 to 2), there is a solid black point labeled "P" directly above it.
